summary: Iter-41 retest of all 3 fixes from iter-40 action items. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest pass — added 4 new tests covering the brand-new POST /api/pickups/{id}/finalize endpoint (unknown→404, no-template→400 with exact detail string, explicit payload→PDF uploaded + idempotency on second call, branch_admin cross-branch→403). critical_code_review_comments: Finalize endpoint implementation is clean: branch_admin RBAC check uses str() coercion for ObjectId comparison (safe), idempotent fast-path returns _serialise(pickup) before touching Cloudinary, fallback to signature_request only when payload sig fields are missing AND status=='signed'. All 4 spec error paths return correct status codes with expected detail strings.

_render_and_upload uses a timestamp-based public_id; the idempotency guard in finalize_pickup() prevents duplicate uploads as long as `signed_pdf_url` is set. Behaviour confirmed via 1.5s-delayed second call returning identical url + finalized_at.

PickupHistorySection catch+console.error added in iter-40 was correct — it just didn't fire in iter-40 because the component was never reached (stale build). With current build the section mounts, fetch returns 200, and rows render. No silent failure observed.

Edits to /app/frontend/src/** require `cd /app/frontend && yarn build` for changes to surface — there is NO hot reload here despite the env docs. This was the iter-40 ghost bug. 2) Backend HTTP suite /app/backend/tests/test_pickups_http.py is fully passing (10/10) and reusable. 3) Browser /api/* routing trick: the static frontend has axios baseURL=/api but neither localhost:3000 nor the preview URL proxy /api → backend. Tests must use page.route('**/api/**', ...) to rewrite to http://localhost:8001/api/*. 4) ofir1 IL admin login still 500s (pre-existing); use ofir2 USA admin for branch_admin scenarios. RBAC check on /finalize fetches branch from /api/auth/me of the branch_admin and skips if branches happen to match — see test_finalize_branch_admin_other_branch_403. 5) job-row data-testid uses job_number not _id: `[data-testid="job-row-595"]`.
rca of the issue: Iter-40 reported 'PickupHistorySection does not render despite backend returning data; catch block added for visibility'. Iter-41 RCA: the catch block never fired because the component code itself was never shipped to the browser — frontend is served by `serve build` from /app/frontend/build, which contained a build from 12:58 while the iter-40 PickupHistorySection edits were saved at 13:50. The deployed JS chunk for /dashboard/jobs literally did not contain the string 'pickup-history-section'. Fix: ran `yarn build` (already part of normal deploy script per package.json), restarted frontend supervisor, and re-tested → section renders with 3 rows on job #595. No backend or component code change was needed for the frontend issue. The new POST /pickups/{id}/finalize endpoint behaves exactly per spec — verified all 4 error paths + idempotency + PDF magic-bytes.
